message: The other day, I found myself knee-deep in the pantry, trying to remember where I hid the extra cans of soup. You know, the ones I bought during last year’s hurricane prep? Turns out, they were behind the flour and next to a box of expired crackers. I had to laugh — not exactly emergency-ready when your supplies are playing hide and seek! At least I’m now inspired to keep things organized for the next storm. How do you keep your emergency stash in check?
